title: Sebastian and the Salt
author: Emrys Dravenmoor
blurb: Hazel Voss, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
